name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and operates Nginx for three HTTPS-enabled static sites, including virtual hosts, TLS, redirects, security headers, compression, logging, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, manages Redis logging and configuration, and provides Redis password authentication and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions Python and PostgreSQL dependencies, deploys the FastAPI application from GitHub, configures its virtual environment and database, and runs it under systemd with Uvicorn.
